11. 2dsphere indexes (v2 and later) are always sparse. MongoDB ignores the `sparse` option. A document is not indexed if the geo field is missing, `null`, or an empty array. https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/indexes/index-types/geospatial/2dsphere/ 12. Sparseness on the geo field started with index version 2. https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-9639 13. In a compound index, only the 2dsphere field decides whether a document is indexed. A document with the scalar fields but no geometry is absent from the index. This matters when you expect the compound index to serve non-geo queries.

27. If a single-ring query polygon is larger than a hemisphere and has no custom CRS, `$geoWithin` and `$geoIntersects` query the complementary (smaller) region instead.
